long_biography.plain_text:
A corporate consolidation linked Marco Romanetto's business interests in Britain and Italy. UK Freedom, the British company he had directed since its formation, absorbed Euro Group through a cross-border merger. Both companies were under the same full owner, and the combination took effect three years after UK Freedom's 2015 incorporation.

Romanetto served concurrently at ADV Enterprise, another London business-support company. His appointments at the two British firms ended together in December 2024, when the same successor joined their boards. UK Freedom remained active after the change, with registered activities in public relations, specialised design and business support. Romanetto's legal relationship with that company continued through share ownership, voting rights and the power to appoint or remove directors.
